lab.prompt: What are you grateful for today?
lab.promptHelp: Even the smallest thing is worth remembering.

lab.quoteLabel: A thought to take with you

first.name: Minh An
first.body:
This morning, I woke up a little earlier. Instead of reaching for my phone, I sat by the window and finished a glass of warm water.

It turns out a good day can begin with something very small.

second.body: Some days feel ordinary, but writing them down reminds me there are still so many things to appreciate.
second.one: Mum called, just to ask what I had eaten.
second.two: A stranger held the lift door for me.
second.three: I let myself rest without feeling guilty.

third.name: Thảo Nhi
third.body:
The little plant on my desk has a new leaf. I thought it had stopped growing.

Maybe I’m like that too. Some changes need time. We just can’t see them yet.

fourth.name: Hoàng Nam
fourth.body: Today I finished something I had put off all week. It isn’t perfect, but I started. I’m grateful for a friend who worked alongside me all afternoon.
fourth.quote: You don’t have to do everything today. Just start with one small thing.
